phkd.note: The orchestrator refuses any action whose gates don't hold. Planned capabilities (ads, LLM answers, quizzes, composition) return blocked-* statuses until real providers/inventory exist.

policy.disclosure: — announcement by the AI Radio Assistant (rule-based).
rules: Never claim anything not present in the manifest/content library (PHKD).
Never play a track outside its commerce access state.
Every spoken output ends with the AI disclosure.
Ads stay blocked without verified inventory.
Purchases are suggestions routed through the existing checkout — never executed by the agent.
LLM cognition is opt-in via AGENT_LLM_PROVIDER; absent provider ⇒ rule engine only.

capabilities.name: Select Station
capabilities.description: Pick a station lane matching daypart/context from the real manifest.

capabilities.name: Play Track
capabilities.description: Queue a track rights-aware: full only for free-tier/entitled; otherwise 45s preview.

capabilities.name: Announce
capabilities.description: Spoken introduction via TTS persona, built ONLY from manifest facts (station, title, version).
gates: text derived from manifest fields only — no fabricated claims

capabilities.name: Recommend
capabilities.description: Suggest catalogue tracks from the same station/version group.
gates: recommendations limited to real catalogue entries

capabilities.name: Suggest Purchase
capabilities.description: Transparent upsell after repeated previews, at real server prices via the existing commerce flow.
gates: only after upsellAfterPreviews previews of the same track
disclosed as a suggestion, never auto-purchased

capabilities.name: Weather Brief
capabilities.description: Speak the real weather gate output; silent when the provider is NULL.
gates: only when /api/weather returns status ok — never fabricated

capabilities.name: Insert Ad
gates: BLOCKED: requires rights-verified ad inventory + ENABLE_ADS=1 (none exists)

capabilities.name: Answer Question
capabilities.description: Answer listener questions about tracks/science with cited sources.
gates: BLOCKED: requires a wired knowledge lane (search/corpus) + LLM provider (AGENT_LLM_PROVIDER) — answers must cite verified sources only

capabilities.name: Run Quiz
gates: BLOCKED: quiz content type has no real content yet

capabilities.name: Compose Content
capabilities.description: Generate micro-podcasts / new lyrics / AI music.
gates: BLOCKED: requires generation provider + rights lane for generated output
